tagline: STIHL equipment, parts, and service for Amberley locals
heroSubheading: Equipment, parts, and service for your Southern property work.
aboutHtml:
We're Jim and Ryan Bassett, running the STIHL SHOP here in Amberley. We stock a full range of STIHL equipment and parts, from chainsaws and trimmers to the smaller tools locals rely on for their properties and gardens. Whether you're maintaining land, clearing scrub, or tackling a bigger job, we've got what you need.

We don't just sell. We service and repair STIHL equipment with genuine parts, and we're here to help you choose the right tool for the work and show you how to use it properly. When your gear needs work, we know STIHL inside out.

Come in and have a chat. We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, and Saturdays 9am to noon. You'll find us ready to help.
whatMakesUsSpecial: Open Monday to Saturday for you
